full_prompt_en: An abstract mixed-media landscape combines blue-grey water, a clouded distance and fine wildflowers with weathered rectangular fragments. The square composition is built from overlapping sections whose seams remain visible, so the view reads both as a landscape and as a layered painted surface. Across the upper half, slate blue and faded turquoise patches alternate with large sand-coloured areas and rubbed grey marks. The cloud-like blue and white band near the middle distance spreads unevenly from the left, breaking beneath translucent layers and scraped surface traces. Beneath it, narrow ochre-gold lines stretch horizontally across the muted blue water. These irregular streaks form a low luminous band without becoming a sharply drawn horizon. Some lines continue across panel boundaries, while others stop against worn patches of beige and brown. At the right edge, tall pale rectangular forms and narrow dark recesses suggest fragments of a wall or doorway, partly absorbed into the surrounding collage. Their vertical edges contrast with the shallow horizontal water bands, but they do not resolve into a complete building. The lower part darkens into charcoal, olive and grey-green, supporting a loose network of slender stems. Several pink flower heads cluster slightly left of the lower centre, accompanied by scattered tiny yellow blooms. Thin green stalks rise through darker ground, crossing the faded layers above without concealing them completely. Small open gaps between the stems preserve the sense of distance behind this delicate foreground. Surface marks range from translucent washes to dry scratches, rubbed patches and granular deposits. Some areas look scraped back to a pale ground, while adjoining rectangles retain denser blue or brown pigment. The worn transitions soften the boundaries between depicted space and material texture. Diffuse cool light spreads through the distant pale band; ochre and muted gold add warmth across the water and the upper rectangular patches. The foreground retains darker values, allowing its small pink and yellow accents to remain distinct. The overall composition balances shallow horizontal distance, broken rectangular structure and fine vertical growth in a quiet, weathered blue-and-ochre field.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅抽象混合媒介景观，将蓝灰水面、云雾般的远景与细小野花叠合在风化矩形碎片之间。方形构图由彼此覆盖的区域组成，拼接痕迹仍然可见，使画面同时呈现景观空间与层叠绘画表面。上半部，石板蓝和褪色青绿色斑块交替出现在大片沙色区域与灰色擦痕之间。中远处近似云带的蓝白色区域从左方不均匀铺开，在半透明色层和刮擦痕迹下时断时续。其下，窄窄的赭金色线痕横贯低饱和蓝色水面。这些不规则笔痕形成低矮亮带，却没有构成锐利勾勒的地平线。有些线条穿过拼接边界继续延伸，有些则终止于米色和棕色旧化斑块。右边缘可见高而浅的矩形与窄暗缝隙，近似墙体或门框的碎片，部分融入周围拼贴。它们的竖边与浅浅的横向水带形成对照，却没有组成完整建筑。画面下部加深为炭灰、橄榄色与灰绿，托起松散交织的细长植物茎。几朵粉色花头聚在下方中央略偏左处，周围散布微小黄花。纤细绿茎穿过较深地面，向上跨入褪色图层，却没有将其全部遮住。茎之间的小空隙保留了细弱前景后方的距离感。表面痕迹包括半透明薄涂、干涩刮线、擦除斑块和颗粒积色。有些区域仿佛刮回浅色底层，相邻矩形中却保留着较浓的蓝色或棕色颜料。磨损般的过渡柔化了所绘空间与材料肌理之间的界限。漫射冷光铺在远处浅色带中；赭色与低饱和金色则为水面和上方矩形斑块加入暖意。前景维持较深明度，使细小粉色与黄色点缀仍能清楚分离。整体构图在安静、风化的蓝赭色场中，平衡浅远横向空间、破碎矩形结构和纤细竖向植物。
style_prompt_en: The mixed-media treatment combines translucent washes, horizontal scraping and weathered rectangular overlays. Slate blue, faded turquoise and grey-green contrast with sand, ochre and subdued gold, while a few small brighter accents interrupt the darker passages. Visible seams, rubbed patches and broken pigment make the surface appear assembled from overlapping fragments. Edges alternate between straight interruptions and soft eroded transitions, allowing fine linear marks to cross broader colour fields. Diffuse light emerges through pale layers, with depth suggested by partial concealment and value changes rather than precise perspective. The overall effect is quiet and materially textured, balancing geometric subdivision with delicate irregular marks.
style_prompt_zh: 混合媒介处理结合半透明薄涂、横向刮擦和旧化矩形叠层。石板蓝、褪色青绿与灰绿对照沙色、赭色和低饱和金色，少量更亮的小色点打断较深区域。可见接缝、擦除斑块和破碎积色，让表面如同由交叠碎片组装而成。边缘在笔直中断和柔软侵蚀式过渡之间变化，纤细线痕跨过较宽色域。漫射亮度从浅色层中透出，空间主要由局部遮挡和明度变化暗示，而非精确透视。整体效果安静且富有材料肌理，在几何分区与细弱的不规则痕迹之间取得平衡。
theme_en: Fragmented blue-grey waterside landscape with wildflowers and ochre rectangular overlays
theme_zh: 蓝灰水岸、野花与赭色矩形拼叠的破碎景观
name: Imants Tillers
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
